research.title: Robustness of Semantic Segmentation Under Illumination Shifts
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to evaluate semantic segmentation under controlled brightness and contrast shifts, separating augmentation effects from architectural differences.
Implemented evaluation pipelines in PyTorch and examined classwise overlap scores and boundary errors to characterize performance changes across lighting conditions.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records by checking incoming deliveries against packing lists and flagging discrepancies for review.
Prepared order paperwork, organized stockroom materials, and coordinated routine handoffs between receiving and dispatch staff.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Retrieval Representations
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, applying consistent preprocessing and distance calculations across representations.
Compared retrieval rankings using labeled image groups and inspected failures involving similar backgrounds, viewpoint changes, and partially occluded objects.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Fine-Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and selective layer fine-tuning for a pretrained image classifier using shared training and validation splits.
Compared classification performance across adaptation strategies and examined confusion patterns among visually similar categories under consistent augmentation settings.
